description: A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted.

description_translations.en: A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted.

description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted.

steps.instruction: Use the FAST test: Face (ask them to smile), Arms (ask them to raise both arms), Speech (ask them to repeat a simple phrase), Time (call emergency services).

instruction_translations.en: Use the FAST test: Face (ask them to smile), Arms (ask them to raise both arms), Speech (ask them to repeat a simple phrase), Time (call emergency services).

steps.instruction: Call emergency services immediately or take them to the nearest major hospital.
